import pathlib
programs=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Solid separator lines partition the board into equal-sized cells.
    row_sep = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    col_sep = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != 0]
    # For these boards, separator lines are the full colored rows and columns.
    def spans(n, cuts):
        edges = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(edges[i] + 1, edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(edges)-1) if edges[i+1] > edges[i]+1]
    rs, cs = spans(h, row_sep), spans(w, col_sep)
    nr, nc = len(rs), len(cs)
    # Row-wise seed colors appear in the first cell column.
    seeds = []
    for r0, r1 in rs:
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(cs[0][0], cs[0][1]) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        seeds.append(vals[0])
    # The non-seed occupied cell carries the pattern to replicate.
    pattern = None
    for ir, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rs):
        for ic, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cs):
            if ic == 0:
                continue
            cells = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            if cells:
                pattern = cells
                break
        if pattern is not None:
            break
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # Retain the colored separator lines.
    for r in row_sep:
        out[r] = list(grid[r])
    for c in col_sep:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = grid[r][c]
    for ir, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rs):
        for c0, c1 in cs:
            for dr, dc in pattern:
                out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = seeds[ir]
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-332eb48b.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
